title: 第二十七章   购物
content_zh:
陈木就知道自己出手会有这样的效果，只能是一脸无奈的继续开车，哦不，现在已经不是一脸无奈了，根本就是面无表情，陈木已经冷岛不能再冷了。

    “陈木，王艺那个人向来都是龇牙必报，你现在让他丢了面子，要是以后他找你的麻烦怎么办？听说他们家……”

    苏林依好心的提醒道，语气里面还有一些担忧，最开始苏林依遇到王艺的时候确实是希望王艺不要粘着自己，但是没有想到被陈木这么简单粗暴的就给解决了，又想起来之前陈木说把花扔在别人脸上的事情，又觉得这样的做法确实是很符合陈木一贯的风格。

    陈木听了苏林依的话，心中莫名的就有一种暖意，那是一种被人关心的感觉，让陈木觉得很舒服。

    “没事，只要不找你们的麻烦就行。”陈木冷静地说道。

    找麻烦？现在她的麻烦已经是一大堆了，还真就不怕再来找死的人，陈木发现自己来到这里的第一天其实就已经是麻烦缠身了，那么就算是再多一点麻烦什么的也无所谓了，顺带一起解决好了。

    “陈木，你还没回答我的问题呢，你是不是一只手就能以一敌百各种吊打对面啊！”孙依诗看着两个人刚刚说话时候水泼不进的气氛，很识相的没有打扰，现在两个人之间没什么说的了，马上就想要知道陈木这酷炫的身手到底是有多厉害。

    “差不多吧。”陈木心不在焉的回答道，心中想的却是，老子巅峰期最厉害的时候根本就不用动手，就能够毁了一个门派，要是真的动起手来的话，估计半个修真界都不够自己玩的，毕竟是渡劫期的大能者，除了劫雷还真就没有什么能够克制的了得。

    “真厉害啊。教教我，教教我好不好？”孙依诗一听到陈木的亲口承认，马上就迫不及待的想要学学陈木这么厉害的身手。

    苏林依无奈的看着孙依诗，说道：“小诗，你要是学会了这个的话，还真就没人值得聊你了，再说了你要是学会了，难道你想让陈木下岗啊？”苏林依本来就是说笑话的，孙依诗才不会学这个东西呢，有这么好的身手估计是练了很久了，而且估计会很刻苦才能够得到这样的效果，孙依诗这姑娘估计也就是看着比较好玩才打算学的，要是真学起来的话，保证不出三天就嚷嚷着不学了，不学了什么的。

    “依依姐，你不觉得我要是学会陈木的功夫，会很酷炫吗？而且陈木不在的时候，我也能够搞定那些很麻烦的人了，依依姐你不觉得这个样子真的很好嘛？”孙依诗一副严肃认真的语气，似乎就是在和苏林以商量这件事一样，但是两个人都知道孙依诗绝对是不会坚持的很久的。

    “小诗啊，你还是不要闹了，你自己也知道这件事情根本就坚持不了的，你看陈木现在额头上都已经出汗了。”苏林依说着还给孙依诗指了指，陈木一僵，知道自己刚刚的事情被发现了。

    刚刚听到孙依诗说道要和自己学习这些东西的时候，真的是吓了一跳，真不知道这看起来娇滴滴的大小姐是怎么想到要学习这么凶残的东西的，虽然孙依诗本来也很活泼好动，叽叽喳喳的，但是也不至于直接出手啊。

    “哈哈哈，木头原来也有你害怕的事情啊，哈哈哈，真好玩，对了，木头你说我和你学习武学怎么样？你身手这么厉害一定能够做我的师父的，你可比我们家其他的保镖厉害多了。”孙依诗一边说着一边还还对着陈木挤眉弄眼。
content_en:
Chen Mu knew that his action would have such an effect, so he could only continue driving with a helpless face. Oh no, he no longer had a helpless face, he just had an expressionless face. Chen Mu was already cold and the island couldn't be cold anymore.

    "Chen Mu, Wang Yi always shows his teeth and retaliates. You have made him lose face now. What if he brings trouble to you in the future? I heard that their family..."

    Su Linyi reminded kindly, with some worries in his tone. When Su Linyi met Wang Yi at first, he really hoped that Wang Yi would not stick to him, but he did not expect that Chen Mu would solve it so simply and rudely. He also remembered what Chen Mu said before about throwing flowers in other people's faces, and felt that this approach was indeed in line with Chen Mu's usual style.

    After hearing Su Linyi's words, Chen Mu felt an inexplicable warmth in his heart. It was a feeling of being cared for, which made Chen Mu feel very comfortable.

    "It's okay, as long as I don't cause trouble for you." Chen Mu said calmly.

    Looking for trouble? Now that she had a lot of troubles, she really wasn't afraid of people coming to kill her again. Chen Mu found that she was already in trouble on the first day she came here, so it didn't matter if it was a little more trouble or something, let's solve it together.

    "Chen Mu, you haven't answered my question yet. Are you able to beat the opponent with one hand against a hundred in all kinds of ways?" Sun Yishi looked at the tense atmosphere when the two people were just talking, and was very understanding and did not interrupt. Now there was nothing to say between the two people, and she immediately wanted to know how powerful Chen Mu's cool skills were.

    "Absolutely." Chen Mu replied absently, but what he was thinking in his mind was that when I was at his peak, he could destroy a sect without even using his hands. If he really did, half of the world of cultivation would not be enough for him. After all, he is a powerful person in the tribulation stage. Apart from the tribulation thunder, there really is nothing he can restrain.

    "It's really amazing. Teach me, teach me, okay?" As soon as Sun Yishi heard Chen Mu's personal admission, she immediately couldn't wait to learn Chen Mu's powerful skills.

    Su Linyi looked at Sun Yishi helplessly and said, "Xiao Shi, if you learn this, no one will really talk to you. Besides, if you learn it, do you want Chen Mu to be laid off?" Su Linyi was always telling jokes, and Sun Yishi would not learn this. To have such good skills, he must have practiced for a long time, and he must have worked very hard to achieve such results. This girl Sun Yishi probably planned to learn it because it was more fun. If she really learns it, I guarantee that she will stop learning within three days, and she will not learn anything.

    "Sister Yiyi, don't you think it would be cool if I learned Chen Mu's Kung Fu? And when Chen Mu is not here, I can also deal with those troublesome people. Sister Yiyi, don't you think this is really good?" Sun Yishi had a serious tone, as if she was discussing this matter with Su Linyi, but both of them knew that Sun Yishi would never persist for a long time.

    "Xiao Shi, you'd better stop making trouble. You yourself know that you can't handle this matter at all. Look, Chen Mu is already sweating on his forehead." Su Linyi said and pointed at Sun Yi Shi. Chen Mu froze, knowing that what he had just done had been discovered.

    I was really shocked when I heard Sun Yishi saying that she wanted to learn these things from herself. I really don’t know how this petite-looking lady thought of learning such cruel things. Although Sun Yishi was also very lively and chattering, she would not take action directly.

    "Hahaha, it turns out that Mu Mu also has the things you are afraid of. Hahaha, that's really funny. By the way, Mu Mu, what do you think I would like to learn martial arts from you? You are so skilled that you can be my master. You are much better than the other bodyguards in our family." Sun Yishi winked at Chen Mu as she spoke.
